newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 117,400 running bales (RB) exceeded the previous week by 24 percent, but were 28 percent less than the 4-week average. The major purchasers were China (43,500 RB including 46,800 in new sales, 1,800 in destination changes and 4,500 in cancellations), Indonesia (25,000 RB including 18,600 in new sales and 6,500 in destination changes), South Korea (19,500 RB), and Mexico (9,300 RB).
Sales for the 1997/98 marketing year of 15,400 RB were for Mexico (11,700 RB) and Canada (3,800 RB).

Exports of 107,100 RB were 6 percent above the week earlier and one-third above the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 72 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 23 percent; African, 2 percent; East European, 2 percent; and West European, 1 percent.
